note: Pale-peach questions room with a green carpet (cartoon style). Landmark: the giant detective's magnifying glass on its stand. Back row left to right: qui (man with a giant key), où (owl with binoculars), pourquoi (poor man with empty pockets), quoi (quacking duck); front row: comment (man puzzling over a booklet and a heap of parts), quel (diver comparing two strands of kelp), combien (woman combing beans), lequel (man pointing at the hats on the stand). Zoom: the little pupil's desk at the back left (la question). The open door at the back left goes out to the school yard; the green door on the right leads to the pronouns hall. Question words have no gender (divider null).
